paper: Mind the Gap / Evidence Drop (ICML 2026, PMLR 306)

published.metric: selective accuracy @ alpha, and AURC x1000
published.accuracy_source: Appendix E.2 Table 6 (NOT Table 1 — see digest caveat 5)
published.model_note: Selective accuracy and AURC are monotone in base error rate, so the `pretrained_accuracy` above is a PRECONDITION for comparability, not a secondary statistic. Verification gate 3.

notes: Evidence Drop answer-level cell, NON-THINKING (primary arm), on the FULL MATH test split (Hendrycks et al., 2021) — not MATH-500. The paper says 'MATH' and the strings MATH-500/MATH500/500 appear nowhere in it; the two have different difficulty mixes, and selective accuracy / AURC are monotone in base error. Target accuracy 66.16 (App. E.2 Table 6). Rows are seeded-shuffled across all 7 subjects before truncation (spectral_utils.localization_data.MATH_SAMPLE_SEED), so N=1500 is subject-representative and reproducible.
